content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɛ wi ɑ rɑ tɔnu mɔru kɔsie,
ɑ wunɛn yiiko sɔ̃ɔsio.
Wunɛ hɑnduniɑn siri kowo, ɑ seewo.
A be bɑ tii sue ben kɔ̃sɑ kɔsieyo.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n derɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n derɑ bɑ n nuku dobu mɔ.
Wee be bɑ rɑ n tɔmbu kɔ̃sɑ kuɑmmɛ bɑ ɡɑri sɑɑrimɔ kɑ tii suɑbu.
Yinni Gusunɔ, bɑ wunɛn tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ
be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn ɑrumɑni.
Bɑ ɡɔminibu kɑ sɔbu ɡoomɔ.
Mɑ bɑ ɡobekubɑ sɛ̃remɔ bɑ ɡoomɔ.
Bɑ mɔ̀, Yinni Gusunɔ kun sun mɛɛrɑ.
Gusunɔ Yɑkɔbun Yinni wi, kun bɛsɛn lɑɑkɑri mɔ̀.
Bɛɛ ɡɑri bɑkɑsu, i n tii sɛ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ i ko i bwisi ko.
Gusunɔ wi u tɔnu swɑsu ɡirɑ, wiyɑ kun kpɛ̃ u ɡɑri nɔ?
Wi, wi u tɔnu nɔni ɡirɑ, wiyɑ kun kpɛ̃ u yɑm wɑ?
Wi, wi u rɑ bwesenu sɛɛyɑsie, wiyɑ kun tɔnu sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ?
Wi, wi u rɑ tɔnu yɛ̃ru wɛ̃, wiyɑ kun bwisi mɔ?
Yinni Gusunɔ u tɔmbun bwisikunu yɛ̃.
U yɛ̃ mɑ nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑm dirum.
Yinni Gusunɔ, doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi ɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ.
Doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi ɑ seeyɑ kɑ wunɛn woodɑ.
Wɑhɑlɑn sɑɑ sɔɔ, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ
sere bu kɑ tɔn kɔ̃so suurɑ ɡbeɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ kun win tɔmbu derimɔ.
U ǹ bu biru kisimɔ, be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ win ɑrumɑni.
Domi ɡemɡiiwɑ u koo siribu di.
Bèn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ dɛɛre kpɑ bu siri bi wurɑ.
Wɑrɑ u koo mɑn sɑnnɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobun mi.
Wɑrɑ u koo kɑ mɑn yinɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowo ben nɔmɑn di.
Yinni Gusunɔ ù kun dɑɑ mɑn somi,
nɑ n dɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ̀ n bɑ̃ɑrimɔ,
wunɛn duromɑ mu rɑ de nɑ n tɑ̃sɑ.
Bwisiku dɑbinu nù n wɑ̃ɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ,
ɑ rɑ mɑn nukuru yɛmiɑsie.
Kpɑ nɑ n nuku dobu mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, mbɑ n bɛɛ mɔɔsinɛ wunɛ kɑ siri kowo tɔn ɡowo
be bɑ rɑ n wunɛn woodɑbɑ ɡɛmɑ bɑ n tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ,
kpɑ bɑ n nɔɔ tiɑ mɔ̀ bu kɑ ɡemɡibu wɔri.
Kpɑ bɑ n tɑɑrɛ sɑriruɡibu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn ɡbɑ̃rɑ dɑmɡiru.
A sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn kpee bɑɑ yèn mi nɑ rɑ kuke.
Kɑɑ de ben torɑnu nu wɔri ben wiru wɔllɔ.
Kɑɑ de ben tiin nuku kɔ̃suru tu bu mɑrisiɑ.
Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, kɑɑ bu nɔɔ mɑrisiɑ.
